layout.arrangement: White slide with a thin dark-red rectangular frame. Title top-left in red bold. Top-right legend row: small yellow chip with '-∞', red circled-asterisk '⊛', empty yellow rectangle, yellow circle with slide number '54'. Below, one large light-pink rounded panel spans almost the whole slide (~88% width × ~77% height) and contains a single left-to-right flowchart: [Z₁-Z₄ embedding stack] → [W_k boxes → K₁-K₄] → [tan Dot Product box with 4 blue dots] → [pale-pink 'Scaling by -√d' box (text marked [?]), fraction K,q/√d above] → [green Mask box with cells -∞,-∞,0,0] → [near-white Soft max box] → [four red ⊗ nodes fed from the right by V₁-V₄ coming from W_v boxes and a second Z₁-Z₄ stack] → [pale-blue Σ box] → [green arrow up to output Z box at top]. Bottom strip: dashed green container with input embeddings Z₁-Z₄ (Z₂ highlighted magenta, red arrow pointing up at it) feeding W_q → q₂ into the Dot Product box; dashed green curved connectors tie this bottom container to the left and right Z stacks. Bottom-right dashed green box shows the 1×d · W(d×d) = 1×d legend with caption 'd: Embedding Length'. Tiny solid black rectangle at the extreme bottom-left corner outside the frame.

layout.hierarchy: The pink panel dominates (~68% of slide area: ~88% width × ~77% height). Prominence order: (1) red bold title; (2) large colored flow boxes — tan Dot Product, green Mask, pale-blue Σ, green W boxes; (3) the dense red arrow network; (4) small bold black/red annotation labels; (5) tiny top-right legend chips and the yellow '54' slide-number circle.

visual_elements.description: Masked self-attention data-flow diagram, left to right inside the pink panel. GROUP 1 (far left): dashed green rounded container holding four embedding rows, each a yellow cell labeled Z₁/Z₂/Z₃/Z₄ followed by three green cells; red arrows exit right. GROUP 2: four solid light-green rectangles labeled W_k^(r), each followed by a small yellow+green strip labeled K₁, K₂, K₃, K₄ (red text); red arrows continue right. GROUP 3: tan vertical rectangle titled 'Dot Product' (two lines) containing four blue dots stacked vertically; red arrows from each K strip meet the dots; thin red diagonal arrows interconnect the dots (pairwise similarity); red arrows exit the upper right toward the next stage; red label 'K,q' at the box top-right; yellow rounded label 'Similarity' floats above. GROUP 4: pale-pink vertical rectangle with rotated black text 'Scaling by -√d' [?] (a small dash precedes √d in the source); red fraction 'K,q' over '√d' above-right; red arrow from Dot Product into it. GROUP 5: green vertical rectangle labeled 'Mask' (black bold, top) containing four white cells stacked top-to-bottom: '-∞', '-∞', '0', '0'; red arrow from Scaling; below the box a black ellipse with yellow bold text 'Look Ahead Mask'. GROUP 6: near-white vertical rectangle with rotated black text 'Soft max' plus a large 'ς' glyph; red arrow from Mask; yellow rounded label 'Probabilities' above. GROUP 7: four red circled-times (⊗) nodes stacked vertically; red arrows fan from Soft max to all four, the top arrow labeled '0' in red; red arrows also arrive from the right from value strips V₁, V₂, V₃, V₄. GROUP 8 (right mirror): dashed green container with rows Z₁-Z₄ → red arrows → four green boxes W_v^(r) → strips labeled V₁-V₄ → red arrows leftward into the ⊗ nodes. GROUP 9: red arrows rise from each ⊗ node into a pale-blue rectangle containing a large black 'Σ'; yellow rounded label 'Weighted SUM' above; thick green arrow points up from Σ. GROUP 10: dashed green box at top containing a yellow cell 'Z' plus green cells (output embedding) receiving the green arrow. GROUP 11 (bottom): dashed green container with four strips Z₁-Z₄; dashed green curved connectors run from its left end up to Group 1 and from its right end up to Group 8 (same embeddings); red arrow rises from the highlighted Z₂ strip to a pink rectangle 'W_q^(r)', then to a strip labeled 'q₂' (red text, yellow+green cells), then a red arrow enters the Dot Product box from below.

Emphasis highlight: the second strip (Z₂) in the bottom input-embedding container is filled magenta/orchid with a dashed magenta border, and a thick red arrow points up at it from just below the container.

Top-right legend/slide-number row on white: (a) small yellow rectangle containing red '-∞'; (b) red circled-asterisk '⊛' symbol; (c) empty yellow rectangle; (d) yellow circle with black bold '54' (slide number).

Bottom-right weight-matrix legend inside a dashed green rounded box: strip of yellow cells annotated '1×d' (red), yellow rectangle 'W' with 'd×d' (red) beneath it, red '=' sign, second strip of yellow cells annotated '1×d'; red caption 'd: Embedding Length' at the bottom.
Small solid black rectangle at the extreme bottom-left corner of the slide, outside/below the red frame (likely a video-player artifact).

Subscript indices used throughout (Z₁...Z₄, K₁...K₄, V₁...V₄, q₂); weight matrices carry a tiny superscript in parentheses (reads as (r), possibly (1) — marked [?]). Slide number '54' sits in a yellow circle. No bullet list — the slide is a full-bleed diagram.
